title: CAN Status Register Bit-Field Extraction and Insertion
description:
Hardware peripheral registers pack multiple data fields into one 32-bit register to save address space.

### CAN Status Register Layout:
- Bits [7:0]: Transmit error counter (`tx_count`)
- Bits [15:8]: Receive error counter (`rx_count`)
- Bits [23:16]: Error counter (`error_counter`)
- Bits [31:24]: Reserved

### Tasks:
1. Extract the 8-bit counters using bit-shift and mask (`0xFF`).
2. Insert a new 8-bit `count` into bits [7:0] using read-modify-write without altering bits [31:8].
hint:
To extract: `(val >> shift) & mask`.
To insert: `(reg & ~mask) | (new_val & mask)`.
